description: This PHP file contains a test class 'EducationServiceTest' which tests the functionalities of 'EducationService' in the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup and multiple unit tests for methods like getEducationList, deleteEducations, getEducationById, and getEducationByName, mainly focusing on the EducationService's interaction with EducationDao and data handling related to Education entities.

classes.name: EducationServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for the EducationService component, verifying its methods and mock interactions.

methods.name: testGetEducationList
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of an education list via EducationService.

methods.name: testDeleteEducations
methods.description: Tests deletion functionality for education records.

methods.name: testGetEducationById
methods.description: Tests retrieving an Education entity by ID.

methods.name: testGetEducationByName
methods.description: Tests retrieving an Education entity by name.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creating an instance of EducationService and populating test data.
